steps.title: Look underground
steps.say: Geodes are big round rocks underground, from the bottom of the world up to level 30.

steps.title: Spot the outside
steps.say: The outside is a layer of dark gray [smooth basalt](item:smooth_basalt), then white [calcite](item:calcite). You often see it in cave walls.

steps.title: Break in
steps.say: Dig through the layers. Inside is purple amethyst, with crystals growing on the walls.

steps.title: Collect the shards
steps.say: Break the big, fully grown crystals with a [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) to get [amethyst shards](item:amethyst_shard). Small ones give nothing.

steps.title: Leave the budding blocks
steps.say: [Budding amethyst](item:budding_amethyst) grows new crystals but breaks if you mine it. Leave it, and come back later for more.

steps.title: Use your shards
steps.say: Make a [spyglass](item:spyglass) from 1 [amethyst shard](item:amethyst_shard) and 2 [copper ingots](item:copper_ingot), or [tinted glass](item:tinted_glass) from shards and [glass](item:glass).
